findings: Original changes 40 catalog description strings and corresponding handler registration descriptions, plus test helper and live buildCatalog assertions. No runtime handlers or schemas changed in original hunks.

Main already tests committed catalog descriptions for non-empty and <=200 chars, then compares live registry descriptions to catalog entries, but that loop does not independently test extra live registrations absent from catalog. Candidate restores original buildCatalog live-registration budget assertion while keeping main equality test.

Original ashlr__read description says bypassSummary:true returns full contents, but main handler description and schema say truncation remains. Actual main servers/read-server.ts must retain current behavior; copying original wording would mislead callers.

Original description wordings across all 40 changed catalog entries are recorded below. Current strings are not asserted semantically equivalent merely because they are compact; review full hunks and actual caller behavior before merge. Original wording preservation unresolved.
Original and candidate test excludes tools gated by enableEnv, matching original scope; no weakened cap or skips.
